title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
description: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

items.content_html:
Due to a missing check in the PSD decoder it would be possible to bypass the list-length resource policy when decoding a PSD image. Other security limits would still apply.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-cwpj-h54c-xjpx
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cwpj-h54c-xjpx

items.title: [Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU] ImageMagick: Policy Bypass in PSD decoder

items.content_html:
An of by one in the meta encoder could result in an out of bounds read of a single byte in the meta encoder.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-cr6r-hmj8-pr7r
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cr6r-hmj8-pr7r
items.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick: Out-of-Bounds Read of a single byte in meta encoder

items.content_html:
An of by one in the meta encoder could result in an out of bounds read of a single byte in the meta encoder.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-cr6r-hmj8-pr7r
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cr6r-hmj8-pr7r
